payload.summary: Two high-severity production advisories sit on main and make the dependency audit blocking for any PR that touches package.json
payload.detail: npm audit --omit=dev on main reports browserslist <=4.28.6 (two high advisories) and fast-uri 3.0.0-3.1.5 (four high advisories). CI's Safety and config checks job runs the dependency audit as blocking only when a PR changes dependency files, so these are invisible until one does - audit remediation P3 hit exactly that and had to revert an otherwise-correct dependency declaration. Open Dependabot PRs #2568, #2570 and the combined #2616 fix both. Recorded 2026-09-04.
